connector.name: Datanika MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only-by-default MCP for Datanika: browse data, run dbt transforms, manage ELT pipelines.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package datanika-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.datanika. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DATANIKA_URL
env.description: Datanika instance URL (defaults to https://app.datanika.io; set this for a self-hosted instance)

env.name: DATANIKA_API_KEY
env.description: Datanika API key (from Settings -> API Keys)

env.name: DATANIKA_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Set to true to enable write/trigger tools (read-only by default)
